stack: Go monolith + html/template + HTMX + SQLite (modernc.org/sqlite) + systemd binary deployment. No new runtime dependencies.

technical_debt.substitution: The three FR-077 browser e2e test cases are implemented as authenticated Go handler/template tests that verify the rendered metric option order, transition-rule disclosure script, and HTMX rules-table partial swap. No Playwright runner was added.
technical_debt.reason: The parent Ultron repo does not have a browser e2e stack for feature verification, and adding one would introduce a new runtime dependency contrary to the single-binary/no-new-runtime constraint. The tested server-rendered HTML and inline disclosure script are the implementation surface used by the browser.
